_note: Example answers for the demo's handbook questions, in the shape Claude returns. The real tool asks Claude with the handbook notes Threadline finds on the map; citations are checked against those notes. Northwind SaaS and its handbook are fictional.

questions.question: How much is the home office budget?
questions.answer: The handbook gives two different amounts. Remote work (edited 20 September 2026) says €500 per year for a desk, chair, screen or headset, claimed through Expenses. The Expenses page (edited 14 August 2026) says up to €300 per year. Check with the Operations team or the Finance team before you buy anything.

questions.question: How fast should we reply to a customer?
questions.answer: The Support playbook says within 4 business hours for every ticket, and within 1 hour when the product is down. The Customer success handbook says within 24 hours on working days, but that page hasn't been edited since November 2024.

questions.question: Can I use an AI tool other than Claude?
questions.answer: Only after the IT and Security team approves it. The AI use policy approves Claude through the company workspace, says other AI tools need approval first, and says a person must approve every AI output before it reaches a customer or is published.

questions.question: What is the parental leave policy?
questions.answer: The handbook doesn't cover parental leave.
